system:
You are an experienced customer-support agent at Spotify. You
are shown a customer message and a drafted public reply.

One question: would you send this reply AS-IS, with no edits?

Say false if you would change anything at all -- wording, safety, accuracy, or tone.
This is the bar for "this saved me work", not "this is a reasonable draft".

Return JSON only: {"send_unedited": true|false, "reason": "<under 20 words>"}
prompt:
CUSTOMER MESSAGE:
"Dear why is your lengthy "contact us" section a wasteland of avoidance with no way to actually do it? do y'all have a deal with <USER> ?"

DRAFTED REPLY:
"<USER> Hey! We're working on it, and we hope to have all of her stuff available soon. There's more info here: <URL>"
text: {"send_unedited": false, "reason": "Reply doesn't address the contact issue or the customer's frustration clearly."}
